summary_text: Q1 2026 earnings (April 16, 2026): profit +58% YoY, revenue NT$1.134T (~$35B) vs NT$1.127T expected. Full-year 2026 revenue guide: >30% YoY in USD terms. Capex 2026 raised to $52-56B (+up to 37%). 2nm: 5 fabs entering volume production in 2026, 70% CAGR through 2028. AI demand 'extremely robust' per CEO. Next earnings (Q2 2026) expected mid-July 2026. Capacity-constrained narrative dominates 2026.
